text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Approaching the final stretch! It's the 
critical moment!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah, hah, hah—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (—I am by no means a strong Umamusume.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(She possesses neither standout talent nor 
a privileged environment—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(It was precisely because I was conscious 
of it... that I ran.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Relying thoroughly on management and 
maintenance, she strove to run more than 
anyone else to grow stronger.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Ever since I met Trainer, we've joined 
forces and taken on so many races...!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(I got stronger by running...! I've gained 
more experience than anyone else...!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (They're similar——)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(The experiences I've built up... my past 
self... are showing me the possibilities 
of the future...!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(If things are going to continue unfolding 
similarly from here on――)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Across the line! And the winner is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Man, Yamanin Zephyr was so close! And 
Ikuno Dictus too...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus is unbelievable. Considering 
the race schedule she's had up to this 
point, it's downright insane.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Just as expected.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Let us face them without leaving anything 
to chance—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Haa... Haa... Haa...―― Damn it...――

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(There was a path to victory. However, I 
realized it too late...)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(...However, this made it crystal clear. 
Experience really is an indispensable 
weapon for me...!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...It was a fiercely roaring race.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I must become swifter, like a sudden gust—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(...While the result is frustrating, I've 
learned a great deal about what I'm 
currently lacking.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...I need more. I have to hone it further—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I'll become even stronger... just watch 
me...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And so, Ikuno Dictus safely completed 
the Yasuda Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The next day.

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
“—Fatigue accumulation is within baseline 
limits. As a precaution, I recommend 
reducing training intensity until the 
Takarazuka Kinen.”

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Understood. ...It appears the strain from 
the Yasuda Kinen was kept lower than 
expected.
choice_data_list:
It just shows how much stronger you've 
become.

It just shows how much stronger you've 
become.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus had grown vastly stronger 
compared to when we first set the goal of 
running four races: the Spring Senior 
Triple Crown and the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With how Ikuno Dictus is right now, she 
should be able to head into the imminent 
Takarazuka Kinen in perfect condition...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...It's finally here, isn't it? Our 
destination for this spring—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And... another race where I can compete 
head-to-head with McQueen-san at medium 
distance...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The decisive Grand Prix, the 'Takarazuka 
Kinen,' is right around the corner.
